_doc: Shared fixture for the product default day-count convention (hierarchy.json default_day_count, resolved by Java DayCounts.resolve / Python resolve_day_count / JS resolveDayCount / Rust resolve_day_count on a bond with no day_count). Read by the Java, JS, Python and Rust tests; all four must agree on every case. Lists every ProductTypeProto value exactly once: each test also checks the case keys equal the generated enum's names, so a new product fails all four suites until it is classified here. day_count is a DayCountConventionProto name; UNKNOWN_DAY_COUNT means the product has no default and the getter returns UNKNOWN_DAY_COUNT, never a guess. Expected values come from this file only. See docs/adr/day_count_convention.md.
